description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseRecognizer' in PHP, which serves as a foundational class for parsers or recognizers within a compiler or interpreter framework. It includes methods and properties for error handling, token management, parsing state, and rule invocation tracking, facilitating the implementation of recursive descent parsing with error recovery capabilities.

classes.name: BaseRecognizer
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionality for language recognizers or parsers in PHP, including error handling, token matching, input state management, rule invocation tracking, and error recovery mechanisms.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the source name associated with this recognizer.

methods.name: getTokenNames
methods.description: Returns an array of token name strings for display purposes; can be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: toStrings
methods.description: Converts a list of tokens into a list of their string representations.

methods.name: getRuleMemoization
methods.description: Retrieves the memoized position where a rule match ended, for input parsing optimization.

methods.name: alreadyParsedRule
methods.description: Checks if a rule has already been parsed at the current input position, optionally seeking forward.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Records the end position of a successful rule parse for memoization.

methods.name: getRuleMemoizationCacheSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of the rule memoization cache.

methods.name: traceIn
methods.description: Logs entry into a specific parser rule for debugging.

methods.name: traceOut
methods.description: Logs exit from a specific parser rule for debugging.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves a token or token type based on a name or identifier.

methods.name: getTokenName
methods.description: Returns the token name string for a given token ID; implementation appears incomplete.
